change_summary: Add a rolling-origin CBB backtest harness (research only) with committed, sha256-pinned game and ESPN close-odds inputs, a verify step that fails on mismatch, a fixed-slice byte-identical reproduction test, and a dedicated offline CI workflow. No model, pricing, ledger, runner or frozen file is changed. PAPER/0u, NON_COUNTED.
assumptions: Only new files under research/cbb_backtest/, docs/governance/changes/pr-538.json and .github/workflows/cbb-backtest.yml. models/, cbb_pricing.py, cbb_run_it.py, the frozen coefficients and research/cbb_hca/ are untouched; the frozen native model is imported read-only.

Historical ESPN odds are an auxiliary research comparator only: not DraftKings execution prices, not authenticated quotes and not CLV evidence. ESPN open lines fail validation, so CLV and open-line ROI stay blocked. 2023 spread and total closes are quarantined.

Reproducible offline from committed text inputs pinned in research/cbb_backtest/data/MANIFEST.json. Still external, hash-pinned only: 18 sportsdataverse parquet files and the raw ESPN odds cache (8.5 MB gz). FG1 comes from PR #534 and is skipped cleanly when absent.

The native home-court repair was chosen on validation seasons after the run-1 test numbers had been seen; its test results are NOT untouched evidence. No result, selection or weight was changed by this reproducibility work.
No model, pricing, calibration, ledger, runner or release change. PAPER/0u, official_counted=0, approved_stake_u=0, NON_COUNTED. No credentials, cookies or tokens are stored.

baseline.metric: Frozen native margin MAE on identical rows, 2019-2026 (points, point-in-time rolling origin)
